technique_name: Explain how machine learning algorithms work.
description: Machine learning algorithms use data to build models that can make predictions and decisions. In essence, these algorithms detect patterns in vast amounts of data and use these patterns to make predictions or decisions. There are numerous types of machine learning algorithms, such as supervised learning algorithms and unsupervised learning algorithms.
